mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `post`) AS postCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `comment`) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `topic`) AS topicCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE create_time >= CURDATE()) AS todayUserCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `post` WHERE created_at >= CURDATE()) AS todayPostCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `comment` WHERE created_at >= CURDATE()) AS todayCommentCount
SELECT id, name, username, avatar, primary_role AS primaryRole, create_time AS createTime FROM `user` ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.type, p.created_at AS createTime, p.views, p.likes, IFNULL(u.name, u.username) AS authorName FROM `post` p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.user_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
